mapper.select: SELECT dv.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, dv.version_code, dv.data_date, dv.status, dv.created_at, dv.completed_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deposit_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS savings_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'ETF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS etf_count FROM kb_product_data_version dv LEFT JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_data_version_id = dv.kb_product_data_version_id LEFT JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id GROUP BY dv.kb_product_data_version_id, dv.version_code, dv.data_date, dv.status, dv.created_at, dv.completed_at ORDER BY dv.data_date DESC, dv.kb_product_data_version_id DESC

SELECT dv.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, dv.version_code, dv.data_date, dv.status, dv.created_at, dv.completed_at, 0 AS deposit_count, 0 AS savings_count, 0 AS etf_count FROM kb_product_data_version dv WHERE dv.kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId}

SELECT dv.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, dv.version_code, dv.data_date, dv.status, dv.created_at, dv.completed_at, 0 AS deposit_count, 0 AS savings_count, 0 AS etf_count FROM kb_product_data_version dv WHERE dv.version_code = #{versionCode}

SELECT dv.kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, dv.version_code, dv.data_date, dv.status, dv.created_at, dv.completed_at, 0 AS deposit_count, 0 AS savings_count, 0 AS etf_count FROM kb_product_data_version dv WHERE dv.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY dv.data_date DESC, dv.kb_product_data_version_id DESC LIMIT 1
